$comment: ADR-037 register fragment (zgw-catalogi-served). Declares catalogi_binding: the catalogue the Catalogi API facade serves (domein, rsin, naam, the uuid it is published under), the register and schema holding the organisation's document types, a field map onto the InformatieObjectType resource, and the ZGW clients that may read it with their scopes. Admin-only: the binding decides what a public, token-guarded API serves and who may read it.

catalogi_binding.title: Catalogi API binding
catalogi_binding.summary: Which catalogue the Catalogi API serves, over which schema of document types
catalogi_binding.description: Serves the organisation's document types as the informatieobjecttypen of one catalogue, so a Documenten API references them and no second catalogue is kept. Only the clients listed here, holding catalogi.lezen, may read it.

domein.title: Domain
domein.description: The catalogue's domain, for example WOO.

rsin.title: RSIN
rsin.description: The RSIN of the organisation that owns the catalogue.

publishedUuid.title: Catalogue uuid
publishedUuid.description: The uuid the catalogue is published under. It stays the same when a register is rebuilt.

register.title: Register
register.description: The register that holds the document types.

schema.title: Schema
schema.description: The schema that holds the document types.

fieldMap.title: Field map
fieldMap.description: Which field of the schema fills which field of an informatieobjecttype. A leading ! inverts a yes/no field. Fields left out keep the default map.

clients.title: Clients
clients.description: The ZGW clients that may read the catalogue, with their scopes.

clientId.title: Client id
clientId.description: The client_id the client's JWT carries.

scopes.title: Scopes
scopes.description: The scopes the client holds. catalogi.lezen reads the catalogue.

concepts.title: Reads concepts
concepts.description: Whether the client may read document types that are still a concept.
